results.title: 40k-Mile 2016 Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat 6-Speed
results.description: This 2016 Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat was purchased by the seller in 2017 and has 40k miles. It is finished in black over black leather, and power is from a supercharged 6.2-liter V8 linked to a six-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential. Features include 20" Strasse wheels, Brembo brake calipers, an SRT-tuned Bilstein suspension, a rear spoiler, heated and ventilated front seats, a Harmon Kardon sound system, and UConnect infotainment with navigation. This Hellcat is offered with black and red keys, the owner's manual, and a clean New York title in the seller's name.
